name: getpeername
synopsis: int getpeername(int sockfd, struct sockaddr *restrict addr, socklen_t *restrict addrlen);
description: getpeername() returns the address of the peer connected to the socket specified by sockfd. It stores the address in the buffer pointed to by addr and updates addrlen with the actual size of the address. If the buffer is too small, the address is truncated.

parameters.name: sockfd
parameters.description: The file descriptor of the socket

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer to store the peer's address

parameters.name: addrlen
parameters.description: Pointer to the size of the addr buffer, which is updated with the actual size on return

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The socket file descriptor is not a valid file descriptor
The addr argument points to memory not in a valid part of the process address space
Insufficient resources were available in the system to perform the operation
The file descriptor does not refer to a socket
